entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the flying ship Weatherlight, who seeks the pieces of the Legacy and agrees to rescue Starke's daughter in exchange for information.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A Talruum minotaur who stands guard for Sisay, resents Gerrard's departure, and later fetches him from Benalia.

entities.name: Starke
entities.description: A scheming informant who sells knowledge of Volrath and the Legacy and then betrays Sisay to Volrath.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: The heir to the Legacy, who left the Weatherlight and lives as a master-at-arms in Benalia until his friends come for him.

entities.name: Pol Cordel
entities.description: Gerrard's older friend in Benalia, who urges him to help his friends and keeps his hourglass pendant.

entities.name: Volrath
aliases: evincar of the Lord of the Wastes
entities.description: A servant of the Lord of the Wastes who holds key pieces of the Legacy and holds Starke's daughter prisoner.

entities.name: Maraxus
entities.description: A monstrous warlord of Keld who threatens Starke in the dark and commands him to bring Sisay.

entities.name: Lord of the Wastes
entities.description: A foe who can only be defeated by the Legacy; Volrath is his evincar.

entities.name: The Legacy
entities.description: The only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes, made of many artifacts forged from destruction, many of them stolen from the child Gerrard.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The flying ship that Sisay captains and that Gerrard rejoins at the end.

entities.name: Gerrard's hourglass pendant
entities.description: The part of the Legacy Gerrard kept, which belonged to his parents and which he leaves with Cordel.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: The city where Gerrard lives as a master-at-arms and where the Weatherlight docks.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: The land whose warlords include Maraxus.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The home of Sisay's village, which her ring reminds her of.

entities.name: Talruum
entities.description: A race of minotaurs to which Tahngarth belongs.

entities.name: Church of Angelfire
entities.description: A religious order whose missionary confronts Tahngarth on the docks.

events.summary: Starke tells Sisay that he knows the Legacy is the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes and that its pieces were stolen from the child Gerrard.
events.quote: I know it to be the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes

events.summary: Starke reveals that the sidar's son is alive and called Volrath, and that he knows where Volrath is and how much of the Legacy he holds.
events.quote: I also know he is alive and now called Volrath.

events.summary: Starke names his price for the information: his daughter.
events.quote: "My daughter," Starke answered.

events.summary: In Benalia, Pol Cordel tells Gerrard that a Talruum has arrived aboard a flying ship, and Gerrard guesses Sisay has come for him.
events.quote: "You think she's come looking for me."

events.summary: Gerrard recalls that chasing the Legacy cost the lives of friends and is why he left the Weatherlight.
events.quote: chasing after the Legacy cost the lives of friends.

events.summary: Cordel's argument persuades Gerrard to go and see the docks.
events.quote: All right then. A convincing argument at last. Which docks?

events.summary: Maraxus corners Starke in his tent at night and threatens to kill him for betraying Volrath's secrets.
events.quote: "You spoke his secrets to an enemy," the figure growled.

events.summary: Starke offers Maraxus the woman who knows where Gerrard is, claiming she can draw Gerrard from hiding, and Maraxus orders him to bring her.
events.quote: "Bring her," it said suddenly.

events.summary: Starke lunges at Maraxus with his dagger but finds only darkness, as Maraxus has vanished.
events.quote: His blade only found darkness. The figure was gone.

events.summary: Gerrard hears Tahngarth roaring at a missionary of the Church of Angelfire on the docks and runs to calm him.
events.quote: "Uh oh," Gerrard murmured, and broke into a run.

events.summary: Gerrard talks Tahngarth out of killing the missionary, and the two are reunited.
events.quote: "Easy, Tahngarth," he murmured, taking the Talruum's arm.

events.summary: Tahngarth tells Gerrard they came to find him because something terrible has happened to Sisay.
events.quote: something terrible has happened.

events.summary: In a flashback, Sisay tells Tahngarth she has agreed to help rescue Starke's daughter from Volrath in exchange for information about the Legacy.
events.quote: This servant, Volrath, is holding Starke's daughter prisoner.

events.summary: Sisay predicts that Gerrard will never be free of the Legacy.
events.quote: He'll never be free of the Legacy. He just doesn't know it yet.

events.summary: Gerrard decides to return to the Weatherlight the next morning, with Cordel arguing he should help his friends.
events.quote: Tomorrow morning I'm going back to the Weatherlight

events.summary: Gerrard leaves his hourglass pendant, the only part of the Legacy he kept, in Cordel's keeping.
events.quote: This belonged to my parents.

events.summary: The Weatherlight, with Gerrard aboard, sets sail from Benalia.
events.quote: The following morning, the Weatherlight , with Gerrard aboard, set sail from Benalia.

events.summary: Starke betrays Sisay by opening a portal at Volrath's command, from which massive hands drag her away.
events.quote: She was alone with the traitor, alone against Volrath's power, directed at her by Starke.

events.summary: Sisay is abducted through the circle, and Starke leaves Volrath's abduction note beside her ring and flees the ship.
events.quote: Starke shivered as he put Volrath's abduction note on the table with Sisay's ring.

events.summary: The Weatherlight, without Sisay aboard, sets sail for Benalia.
events.quote: The following morning, the Weatherlight , without Sisay aboard, set sail for Benalia.

relations.quote: Sisay of the Weatherlight said to the Talruum minotaur standing impassive guard at her stateroom's door.

relations.note: He stands guard at her door and calls her his captain.
relations.quote: but did as his captain suggested.
Gerrard didn't look surprised, but he avoided meeting his friend's eyes.
I came to discuss Volrath, evincar of the Lord of the Wastes
She was alone with the traitor, alone against Volrath's power, directed at her by Starke.

relations.note: Starke suspects Volrath sent him; Maraxus works with Volrath.
relations.quote: He already knew that Volrath and Maraxus would not give him back his daughter
